name: Wuchan Zhongda Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wuchan Zhongda Group Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the bulk commodity supply chain integration services in China and internationally. It operates through Supply Chain Integration Services, Financial Services Business, and High-End industrial Business segments. The company offers metals, energy, chemicals, and automobiles industry; financial leasing, finance companies, futures, pawnbroking, oil and gas trading platforms, asset management, private equity funds, and commercial factoring, as well as wire and cable, cogeneration, tire manufacturing, primary magnesium smelting and magnesium alloy processing, and aluminum die casting.
